import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
sleep_disorder_map = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
for i, disorder in enumerate(sleep_disorder_map.unique()):
    mask = sleep_disorder_map == disorder
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['Sleep Duration'], df[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
               label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=50, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='best')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Average Sleep Quality by BMI Category
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_sleep = df.groupby('BMI Category')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax2.barh(bmi_sleep.index, bmi_sleep.values, color=colors[:len(bmi_sleep)])
ax2.set_xlabel('Avg Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality by BMI', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, v in enumerate(bmi_sleep.values):
    ax2.text(v + 0.05, i, f'{v:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 3. Physical Activity Level vs Stress Level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                     c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Quality', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. Sleep Duration Distribution by Gender
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
for i, gender in enumerate(df['Gender'].unique()):
    data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]['Sleep Duration']
    ax4.hist(data, alpha=0.6, label=gender, bins=15, color=colors[i])
ax4.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend()
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 5. Heart Rate by Sleep Disorder
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
sleep_disorder_clean = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
df_temp = df.copy()
df_temp['Sleep Disorder'] = sleep_disorder_clean
disorder_order = df_temp.groupby('Sleep Disorder')['Heart Rate'].median().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(data=df_temp, y='Sleep Disorder', x='Heart Rate', 
           order=disorder_order, palette='Set2', ax=ax5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Correlation Heatmap
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
           square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax6.set_xticklabels(ax6.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax6.set_yticklabels(ax6.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
